message: `emacro` is no longer part of Axiom
label: `emacro` was a second spelling of a rule-form macro, for rules whose template is one expression; `macro` reads each rule's template as declarations or as an expression, and where the macro is invoked picks
help: write `macro`: `(macro total ((total x) x) ((total x rest ...) (+ x (total rest ...))))` is an expression macro, because each rule's template is one expression
